Research

Key Ingredients

Pullulan: Forms a breathable protective film that locks in mucosal moisture, soothing and protecting. Sodium Hyaluronate + Hydrolyzed Sodium Hyaluronate:** Multi-layer hydration that nourishes delicate intimate mucosa and improves dryness. β-Glucan: Soothes and stabilizes, strengthening the mucosal barrier. Hydrolyzed Collagen + Soluble Collagen:** Replenishes collagen for a soft, supple feel. Oligopeptide-1, Tetrapeptide-4, Glycoprotein:** Multiple active peptides that care for the mucosa and help maintain a healthy intimate state. Glyceryl Citrate / Lactate / Linoleate / Oleate:** Mimics the sebum feel of mucosa, providing soft hydration and helping maintain a mildly acidic environment. Trace Fragrance: Aromatic ingredients that create different scent profiles and help neutralize unwanted odors (the source of variation across the 8 scents).

Dosing & Protocol

Instructions for Use

1.Clean hands thoroughly 2.Put on the disposable finger cot 3.Take out lyophilized ball, gently insert deep into vagina

Note：The ball will gradually dissolve and release nutrients under intimate environment.

Usage Frequency

Daily maintenance: 2-3 times per week Dry & sensitive period: once per night, 7 days as one care cycle
